fieldValues.title: A Protocol definition cannot carry anything not yet specified
fieldValues.summary: All four Protocol schemas are closed and there is no meta carrier, so none of the nine things the minutes runner supplied can be tried inside a definition; and a loose Protocol with an empty targetType cannot be created at all.
evidence: protocol create with extra keys at protocol, stage and aiGuidance level: all refused (build.676)
srs#1054: targetType oneOf accepts the empty string twice
fieldValues.body: Each evolution needs a schema change before it can be tested in place. Until then conventions sit in a profile note or in the tool.
